episode.throughLine: A source-led childhood memory vignette: illness, play, difficulty speaking anger, and music shared with a grandfather. No single crisis-to-turn chronology is claimed.

contentProfile.contentNote: Childhood illness, quarantine and difficulty expressing anger. Short source-led memory vignette, not a full recovery arc. Exact childhood ages are unknown; no medical advice.

arc.canonicalText: In his childhood memories, a boy lay in bed with small figures on the sheet. He was an only child until eleven. He raised his knees beneath the cloth to make mountains. The figures moved around them.
arc.sourceNote: AUTHORIZED SOURCE-LED VIGNETTE EXCEPTION: recurring remembered illness, not one dated scene. Age eleven is the attested only-child boundary, not the exact age of an illness. AGE/INTEGRATION HOLD: metadata 0–18 is an explicitly editorial childhood envelope, not attested event ages. The interviews do not establish confinement to the installed ages 8–13 or stage years.

arc.canonicalText: His memories of childhood included being afraid to say what he felt. He did not want to seem bad by telling people he was angry. Words could be difficult.
arc.sourceNote: AUTHORIZED STRUCTURAL EXCEPTION: remembered difficulty with words, not an attested lowest moment or a reaction assigned to a particular illness or bullying event.

arc.canonicalText: At the piano, he could express anger through the way he played. He remembered finding room there for laughter and tears as well. It felt safe.
arc.sourceNote: AUTHORIZED STRUCTURAL EXCEPTION: habitual expression through music, not a first act immediately after the prior passage. No invented practice session or cure.

arc.canonicalText: Being sick meant repeated stretches in bed, not a single afternoon. He made voices for his figures and invented stories around them. As an adult, he said those characters had helped him through being ill. The play was his own.
arc.sourceNote: AUTHORIZED STRUCTURAL EXCEPTION: recurring conditions and coping, not a demonstrated failed effort. No failure is invented to satisfy the struggle label.

arc.canonicalText: A separate memory held his grandfather playing the fiddle while he accompanied him on piano. He remembered that time with lasting pleasure. They made music together.
arc.sourceNote: AUTHORIZED STRUCTURAL EXCEPTION: a separately remembered accompaniment, not a turning event caused by the earlier passages. The different interview's song-learning memory is not fused into this occasion.

arc.canonicalText: There were also Sunday visits to his grandfather and walks around the grounds. He remembered being welcomed for himself. At eleven, his sister joined the family. He was no longer an only child.
arc.sourceNote: AUTHORIZED STRUCTURAL EXCEPTION: childhood recollections, not consequences caused by the accompaniment. The only stated dated boundary is the arrival of his sister at eleven; the memories are not otherwise ordered.

arc.canonicalText:
His name was Fred Rogers.

He made Mister Rogers' Neighborhood for children.

Your life is not theirs. But a piece of this story may still sit beside you.

Your feelings do not have to arrive as words.
